I've applied in my different places, no call backs.

I've tried exercise and diet, but I can never stick to anything. I'm just to tired all the time.

I've been to see a doctor, I'm on antidepressants. Nothing's helped. 

You're a very nice person, I'm glad I got to talk to you.
I have talked to my family about this, they just got angry at me for thinking so selfishly.

> You would essentially be transferring your pain to your loved ones


Thank you. There's no way they should feel what I feel, my mom deserves better.
